make_sound.name: make_sound
make_sound.description: Makes a Sound with given wave function and duration, using the same wave for both channels. The wave function is a function: number -> number that takes in a non-negative input time and returns an amplitude between -1 and 1.

make_stereo_sound.name: make_stereo_sound
make_stereo_sound.description: Makes a stereo Sound with given left/right wave functions and duration. Each wave function is a function: number -> number that takes in a non-negative input time and returns an amplitude between -1 and 1.

get_wave.name: get_wave
get_wave.description: Accesses the wave function of a given Sound. Meaningful for any Sound built via make_sound (where the left and right wave functions have the same behavior) - for a Sound built via make_stereo_sound with channels that don't, this returns the left channel; use get_left_wave/get_right_wave to be explicit about which channel you mean.

get_left_wave.name: get_left_wave
get_left_wave.description: Accesses the left channel's wave function of a given Sound.

get_right_wave.name: get_right_wave
get_right_wave.description: Accesses the right channel's wave function of a given Sound.

get_duration.name: get_duration
get_duration.description: Accesses the duration of a given Sound.

is_sound.name: is_sound
is_sound.description: Checks if the argument is a Sound.

init_record.name: init_record
init_record.description: Initialize recording by obtaining permission to use the default device microphone. Waits for you to actually respond to the permission prompt before returning, so a script can safely call record()/record_for() right on the next line without racing the permission grant.

record.name: record
record.description: Records a sound until the returned stop function is called. Takes a buffer duration (in seconds) as argument, and returns a nullary stop function. Calling the stop function returns a Sound promise (a nullary function that waits for the recording to finish processing before returning the recorded Sound - so evaluation genuinely pauses there rather than needing to be called again later). The recorded Sound uses however many channels the input device actually has - a mono microphone (by far the most common case) produces a Sound whose left and right wave functions have the same behavior.

record_for.name: record_for
record_for.description:
Records a sound of a given duration. Uses however many channels the input device actually has, same as record.

How the function behaves in detail:

  1. record_for is called.
  2. The function waits for the given buffer duration.
  3. The recording signal is played.
  4. Recording begins when the recording signal finishes.
  5. The recording signal plays to signal the end after the given duration.

play_wave.name: play_wave
play_wave.description: Plays the given Wave using the computer's sound device, for the duration given in seconds, on both channels.

play_waves.name: play_waves
play_waves.description: Plays the given left/right Waves using the computer's sound device, for the duration given in seconds.

play.name: play
play.description: Plays the given Sound using the computer's sound device, as soon as it has finished sampling - concurrently with any Sound(s) already playing, so repeated/looped play() calls overlap and are mixed together rather than erroring or queueing behind each other.

play_in_tab.name: play_in_tab
play_in_tab.description: Adds the given Sound to the sound tab as a play bar with its own start/pause/scrub controls, rather than playing it immediately - unlike play(), nothing is heard until you press play in the tab. Each call adds a new bar (stacked below any earlier ones), so playing several Sounds this way lets you compare/replay each one independently, on its own schedule.

stop.name: stop
stop.description: Stops all currently playing sounds, and cancels any that were queued behind them.

noise_wave.name: noise_wave
noise_wave.description: A wave that is a random value at each sample (44100 samples per second).

noise_sound.name: noise_sound
noise_sound.description: Makes noise: a random wave sampled 44100 times per second, for the given duration.

silence_sound.name: silence_sound
silence_sound.description: Makes a silence Sound with given duration.

sine_wave.name: sine_wave
sine_wave.description: A sine wave of the given frequency.

sine_sound.name: sine_sound
sine_sound.description: Makes a sine wave Sound with given frequency and duration.

square_wave.name: square_wave
square_wave.description: A square wave of the given frequency, approximated via a Fourier expansion.

square_sound.name: square_sound
square_sound.description: Makes a square wave Sound with given frequency and duration.

triangle_wave.name: triangle_wave
triangle_wave.description: A triangle wave of the given frequency, approximated via a Fourier expansion.

triangle_sound.name: triangle_sound
triangle_sound.description: Makes a triangle wave Sound with given frequency and duration.

sawtooth_wave.name: sawtooth_wave
sawtooth_wave.description: A sawtooth wave of the given frequency, approximated via a Fourier expansion.

sawtooth_sound.name: sawtooth_sound
sawtooth_sound.description: Makes a sawtooth wave Sound with given frequency and duration.

consecutively.name: consecutively
consecutively.description: Makes a new Sound by combining the sounds in a given list where the second Sound is appended to the end of the first Sound, the third Sound is appended to the end of the second Sound, and so on. The effect is that the Sounds in the list are joined end-to-end.

simultaneously.name: simultaneously
simultaneously.description: Makes a new Sound by combining the Sounds in a given list. In the result sound, the component sounds overlap such that they start at the beginning of the result sound. To achieve this, the amplitudes of the component sounds are added together and then divided by the length of the list.

adsr.name: adsr
adsr.description: Applies an ADSR envelope to a Sound, modifying its amplitude according to parameters, applied to each channel independently. The relative amplitude increases from 0 to 1 linearly over the attack proportion, then decreases from 1 to sustain level over the decay proportion, and remains at that level until the release proportion when it decays back to 0.

stacking_adsr.name: stacking_adsr
stacking_adsr.description: Applies a list of envelopes to a given wave form. The wave form is a Sound generator that takes a frequency and a duration as arguments and produces a Sound with the given frequency and duration. Each envelope is applied to a harmonic: the first harmonic has the given frequency, the second has twice the frequency, the third three times the frequency etc. The harmonics are then layered simultaneously to produce the resulting Sound.

phase_mod.name: phase_mod
phase_mod.description: Builds a Sound transformer which uses its argument to modulate the phase of a (carrier) sine wave of given frequency and duration with a given Sound, applied to each channel independently (using that channel's own wave as the modulator). Modulating with a low frequency Sound results in a vibrato effect. Modulating with a Sound with frequencies comparable to the sine wave frequency results in more complex wave forms.

squash.name: squash
squash.description: Centers a Sound by averaging its left and right channels, resulting in an effectively mono Sound (both channels are the same, averaged, wave).

pan.name: pan
pan.description: Builds a Sound Transformer that pans a sound based on the pan amount. The input sound is first squashed to mono. An amount of -1 is a hard left pan, 0 is balanced, 1 is hard right pan.

pan_mod.name: pan_mod
pan_mod.description: Builds a Sound Transformer that uses a Sound to pan another Sound. The modulator's two channels are summed and clamped to [-1, 1] to compute the pan amount at each point in time. -1 is a hard left pan, 0 is balanced, 1 is hard right pan.

bell.name: bell
bell.description: Makes a Sound reminiscent of a bell, playing a given note for a given duration.

cello.name: cello
cello.description: Makes a Sound reminiscent of a cello, playing a given note for a given duration.

piano.name: piano
piano.description: Makes a Sound reminiscent of a piano, playing a given note for a given duration.

trombone.name: trombone
trombone.description: Makes a Sound reminiscent of a trombone, playing a given note for a given duration.

violin.name: violin
violin.description: Makes a Sound reminiscent of a violin, playing a given note for a given duration.
